summary: Zion Oil & Gas filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) to announce the commencement of field operations for a planned sidetrack phase of its Megiddo-Jezreel #2 well in Israel, along with the recertification and renaming of its drilling rig to JB-1. There are no deal terms, acquisitions, divestitures, or special-situation events. This is a routine operational update regarding the company's exploration activities. The filing does not trigger any special-situation category.
